traits.name: steady
traits.reason: Only move actions are recorded; no quarrying, five-a-swing pattern, or full pack is shown, and the moves jump between tiles without a clear single-node focus.

traits.name: patient
traits.reason: Several moves around (87-95, 93-98) could be a long walk toward an edge, but there is no ore or stocked-stone context to confirm it.

traits.name: exact
traits.reason: Coordinates are precise in the moves, but there are no public lines naming a tile and load count.

traits.name: gruff
traits.reason: No public lines at all, which is technically terse, but there is no grunt of a line on stocking a store to judge.

traits.name: sparing
traits.reason: No harvesting actions are visible, so there is no evidence of leaving five on any node.
